style_bible.visual_style: Cinematic documentary, modern Vietnamese SME office, realistic
style_bible.color_palette: Navy, cyan and warm neutral accents
style_bible.lighting: Soft daylight with consistent direction from camera left
style_bible.character_consistency: One fictional Vietnamese operations manager, early thirties, navy shirt, no resemblance to a real person
style_bible.location_consistency: Same clean SME office and the same desk setup

voice_bible.description: Male, calm and warm mid-range voice, steady moderate pace, professional consultant tone giving practical operational advice, no dramatic pitch swings.

frames.subject: Operations manager at a crowded workflow screen
frames.image_prompt: Vertical cinematic documentary frame, fictional Vietnamese operations manager in navy shirt facing an overcrowded node workflow, modern SME office, soft daylight from camera left, navy and cyan palette, realistic, no text, no logos
frames.negative_prompt: text, logos, extra fingers, real person likeness

frames.subject: Workflow screen and empty report
frames.action: Data routes into the wrong branch
frames.image_prompt: Vertical over-shoulder cinematic frame, same fictional manager and office, data lines routing into a wrong branch and an empty report represented without readable text, consistent daylight, no text, no logos

frames.subject: Manager holding an attractive but unusable AI output
frames.action: Looks for an absent approval signal
frames.image_prompt: Vertical realistic office frame, same fictional manager holding a polished generic AI result while an approval indicator remains absent, consistent navy cyan style, no readable text

frames.subject: Workflow card
frames.action: Hands arrange input process output cards
frames.image_prompt: Vertical top-down documentary frame, hands arranging three blank workflow cards for input process output on the same desk, navy cyan accents, soft daylight, no readable text

frames.subject: Sample data, expected output and checklist
frames.action: Cards align into a clean sequence
frames.image_prompt: Vertical cinematic desk composition, blank sample data card, expected output card and checklist aligned into a clear sequence, same office, consistent palette, no readable text

frames.subject: Manager and approval control
frames.action: Finger approaches approval, log row appears abstractly
frames.image_prompt: Vertical close cinematic frame, same fictional manager pressing a generic green approval control while an abstract log row appears, consistent office and lighting, no readable text, no logos
frames.negative_prompt: readable text, real UI brand, different character

frames.subject: Clean workflow canvas
frames.action: Manager sees one clear connected flow
frames.image_prompt: Vertical hero frame, same fictional manager viewing one clean connected workflow in the same SME office, calm confident posture, navy cyan palette, soft daylight, no readable text, no logos
